formulas.ascii: Core test, not the labelling: |N(i)| = number of valid points j (point i itself included) with dx^2 + dy^2 <= epsilon^2 in f32; point i is core when |N(i)| >= minimumSamples. Clusters are the connected components of core points under that relation, found by lock-free union-find; a border point (valid, not core, with a core neighbour) joins the adjacent cluster with the smallest root, every other point is noise (0xffffffff). Compact cluster ids follow the smallest core row, so labels are canonical.
